questions.question: Show that −7 + 9 = 9 + (−7), and explain why 5 − (−2) and −2 − 5 are different.
questions.expected_answer: Both sums equal 2: addition of integers is commutative. 5 − (−2) = 7 but −2 − 5 = −7, so subtraction is not commutative.

questions.question: Calculate 4 + (−7) + 9 + (−6) + 3 left to right and by grouping positives and negatives.
Use the properties to calculate −23 + 58 + 23 quickly and explain why it is allowed.
questions.expected_answer: Pair −23 and 23 to make 0, leaving 58. The commutative and associative properties allow reordering and regrouping in a sum.
